name: Senso-ji
description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, in Asakusa, fronted by the Nakamise shopping street.

name: Meiji Shrine
description: Shinto shrine set in a forested park beside Harajuku, dedicated to Emperor Meiji.

name: Tsukiji Outer Market
description: Bustling lanes of seafood stalls, sushi counters and street food near the old fish market.

name: Ichiran Shibuya
description: Famous tonkotsu ramen chain with solo booths, a short walk from Shibuya Crossing.

name: Shinjuku Gyoen
description: Large landscaped park blending Japanese, English and French garden styles.

name: Louvre Museum
description: The world's largest art museum, home to the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

name: Musee d'Orsay
description: Impressionist and post-impressionist masterpieces in a former Beaux-Arts railway station.

name: Centre Pompidou
description: Modern and contemporary art behind a famous inside-out high-tech facade.

name: Eiffel Tower
description: Iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, the emblem of Paris.

name: Le Comptoir du Relais
description: Beloved Saint-Germain bistro serving classic French dishes.

name: Kinkaku-ji
description: The Golden Pavilion, a Zen temple covered in gold leaf above a reflecting pond.

name: Kiyomizu-dera
description: Hillside wooden temple with a vast veranda and views over Kyoto.

name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
description: Shinto shrine famous for thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up the mountain.

name: Gion
description: Historic geisha district of wooden machiya teahouses and lantern-lit lanes.

name: Nishiki Market
description: Covered market lane known as Kyoto's kitchen, with local snacks and produce.

name: Colosseum
description: Ancient Roman amphitheatre that once hosted gladiatorial games.

name: Roman Forum
description: Sprawling ruins of temples and basilicas at the heart of ancient Rome.

name: Pantheon
description: Remarkably preserved ancient temple with a vast unreinforced concrete dome.

name: Trastevere
description: Cobbled neighbourhood packed with trattorias, wine bars and gelaterias.

name: Villa Borghese
description: Landscaped gardens with a lake, museums and shady paths above the city.

name: Park Guell
description: Gaudi's mosaic-tiled hillside park with sweeping views over the city.

name: Montjuic
description: Hilltop park with gardens, a castle, museums and harbour views.

name: Sagrada Familia
description: Gaudi's still-unfinished basilica, a UNESCO masterpiece of Catalan modernism.

name: La Boqueria
description: Vibrant covered food market just off La Rambla.

name: Gothic Quarter
description: Medieval old town of narrow lanes, plazas and the Barcelona Cathedral.
